# Physical activity and fitness hub

*Generated by `tools/domains/build_hubs.py` from `shared/domain-tags.json` and [`literature-library.md`](literature-library.md). Do not edit by hand.*

Everything in the knowledge base tagged **activity**: the measurement-science papers that live in this module, then the device, platform, deployment and methods material that lives in Modules 1 to 4.

## Device and platform profiles

- [Ametris (formerly ActiGraph), CentrePoint, ActiGraph LEAP, Insight Watch](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/ametris-actigraph.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): Research accelerometer, raw acceleration and counts
- [Axivity (AX3 / AX6) and GENEActiv, open research-grade accelerometers](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/axivity-geneactiv.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): Research raw accelerometers for activity
- [Apple Watch / Apple Health / HealthKit / SensorKit](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/apple-watch-healthkit.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Steps, VO2 max, active energy; EE poor
- [Beiwe](../../module-02-digital-phenotyping/profiles/beiwe.md) (Module 2 profile, secondary): Forest Oak outputs walking time, steps, cadence
- [Empatica](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/empatica.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Raw accelerometry and activity counts
- [Fitbit / Google (Fitbit Web API → Google Health API)](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/fitbit-google.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Steps, Active Zone Minutes and VO2 max in API
- [Garmin](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/garmin.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Steps, VO2 max estimates and activity API
- [Samsung (Galaxy Watch / Galaxy Ring / Samsung Health SDK Suite)](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/samsung.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Raw accelerometer SDK and step validity

## Papers in other modules

### Module 1, wearables

- 24h movement behaviours in students vs adults (Oura) (primary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/research-library-wearables.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12916-026-05192-1): Sedentary, activity and sleep minutes per day

- Apple Watch VO2 max validation (primary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0323741): VO2 max estimate vs calorimetry

- Oura energy expenditure and steps validation (primary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12874-023-01868-x): Step and energy expenditure validity of Oura
- Upper limb movements as digital biomarkers in ALS (L044, primary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ebiom.2024.105036): Wearable accelerometer movement in free living; borderline

- Alcohol effects on HR, sleep and physical activity (WHOOP) (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pdig.0001284): Physical activity is one of three outcomes
- Apple Watch accuracy meta-analysis (HR, steps, EE) (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6579/adca82): Pools steps and energy expenditure error
- Apple Watch living systematic review (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/literature-library.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-02238-1): Steps, EE and VO2 among 14 metrics

- Depression and anxiety severity in Oura metrics (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/research-library-wearables.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12916-026-05276-y): Daytime activity is one of several outcomes

- Oura after deep brain stimulation (case report) (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/research-library-wearables.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.7759/cureus.115385): Activity score and steps tracked; borderline
- Pilgrim tiredness from smartwatch physiology and mobility (secondary; [catalogue](../../module-01-wearables/research-library-wearables.md)) [doi](https://doi.org/10.3390/s26175625): Mobility indicators are model inputs
